title: Windblown Silence
author: Tapeshwar Prasad
text:
valley emptied,
except
for dying echoes
in the chambers
of a palpitating heart

I lie down
on sorrow`s floor
and let it slip through
the sticky surface—
that you are no longer here

all bare except what
was placed there to stay:
celestial blue, the green carpet soft,
and your voice
clinging to windblown silence
stanzas: that you are no longer here
celestial blue, the green carpet soft,
